reference.title: Scenario 4: Note in a numbered list item
reference.shortdesc: Consider a Markdown file that documents the procedure for configuring email notifications.

section.p: Consider a Markdown file that documents the procedure for configuring email notifications. One of the procedural steps includes an informational note.

table.title: Note in a numbered list item

entry.codeblock: # Configuring Email Notifications To configure email notifications: 1. Enter the SMTP server address. > [!NOTE] > Ensure that the SMTP server is reachable from the application server. 2. Enter the sender email address. 3. Click **Save**

Configuring Email Notifications

To configure email notifications:

 Enter the SMTP server address. Ensure that the SMTP server is reachable from the application server. Enter the sender email address. Click Save.

section.p: Result: The converter associates the note with the preceding procedural step and places it within an <info> element inside the corresponding DITA <step>. The note becomes supporting information for that step.
